title: Leaving a box out
passage:
You asked me to leave the warranty cards out. Should I take them out of the box?
A. Yes, we still have a whole box of them.
B. No, just don’t put the box back in the cupboard yet.
C. No, the cupboard’s already empty.
passageZh:
你請我把保固卡留在外面。我要把它們拿出盒子嗎？
A. 對，我們還有整整一盒。
B. 不是，只是先別把盒子放回櫃子。
C. 不是，櫃子已經空了。
